label: EXPLORATORY ADDENDUM, DECLARED AFTER THE MAIN STUDY. Never merged into canonical empirical-v2 tables. No significance or state-of-the-art claim.
declaration_rule: Every setting below is committed before any addendum score is computed and is never changed after scoring begins. One execution; every row reported, including unavailable rows and unfavourable results.

E1.name: Fresh-split offline curation on new KEEL datasets (Track B design)

unavailable_datasets.winequality-red-4: SOURCE_ARCHIVE_EMPTY: the supplied winequality-red-4.zip is 0 bytes and the authorized URL https://sci2s.ugr.es/keel/dataset/data/imbalanced/winequality-red-4.zip returned an empty body on 2026-10-29. No mirror or guessed URL is used. All E1/E4 rows for this dataset are recorded unavailable.

E1.split: existing make_split(loaded, split_seed), stratified 80/20; every transformation, generator and evidence model fitted on that split's TRAIN only
E1.budget_rule: b = min(70, max(30, round(0.5 * n_train_minority))) computed per split; round is Python round (half to even)
E1.generator_rule: SMOTENC when the dataset declares any nominal feature, otherwise SMOTE, including integer-declared datasets. Existing rcqasyn.empirical.generation.generate: TRAIN StandardScaler before interpolation, inverse transform after, never rounded.
E1.evidence_and_admission: existing rcqasyn.empirical.generation.fresh_geometry unchanged (M2 refit on split TRAIN, midrank local/global indices, q=0.90 combined admission, M7 geometry)
E1.random_curator_seed: the split seed, exactly as run-v2 Track B; across five splits the selection seeds are 13, 29, 43, 61, 79
E1.minority_quota_note: Inert for minority-only pools; kept at the canonical value.
E1.regimes: curators scored as TSTR and HYBRID_MINORITY via the existing Study.score; TSTR is recorded unavailable because minority-only pools hold one class
E1.structural_noncompliance: count of generated candidates failing complete_record (integer, category, label checks) per split pool and for SMOTE/SMOTENC+b comparators; never coerced
E1.shortfall: a curator whose eligible pool is smaller than b is recorded MATCHED_BUDGET_SHORTFALL/unavailable, never compensated

E1_repair.name: E1 with existing schema checks plus bounded repair
E1_repair.applies_when: dataset declares at least one integer numerical feature; otherwise every candidate is NOT_NEEDED and the variant is recorded NOT_APPLICABLE (identical to E1)
E1_repair.policy: existing rcqasyn.phase6.repair.propose_repair unchanged: integer-half-even-max3-v1 (<=3 integer fields, <=0.5 absolute edit per field, Decimal ROUND_HALF_EVEN; no label invention, imputation or category substitution)
E1_repair.structural_evidence: authoritative_structure evidence from the split's refit TrainEvidenceModel (same object fresh_geometry uses)
E1_repair.pool_construction: each REPAIR_ELIGIBLE candidate is replaced at its ordinal by its repaired payload; ineligible candidates are retained unchanged and remain schema-invalid; then fresh_geometry, admission, curators and scoring run exactly as E1 on that pool
E1_repair.generator_seed_and_budget: identical to E1 for the same split

E2.name: Historical Track A quality-coverage with minority quota at the real TRAIN class ratio
E2.pool: combined-review admitted pool (rcqasyn.phase5.workflow.pool), identical to canonical selection/quality-coverage/s42
E2.change_from_canonical: minority quota = floor(b * TRAIN minority fraction) instead of floor(0.5 * b)
E2.train_minority_fraction: positives / rows in the historical split TRAIN (data/manifests/<id>/split_manifest.json, root seed 42); implemented by SelectionConfig.minority_quota_fraction = that fraction, since select() uses int(budget * fraction)
E2.other_selection_settings: radius 0.05, near tolerance 0.01, concerns = Phase-4 uncalibrated_max, as canonical
E2.comparison_source: primary: the canonical comparators re-scored in this addendum's environment (same code, seeds and pools); run-v2 values are reported beside them with the maximum absolute difference

E3.name: B2 control at an equal budget (historical Track A)
E3.pool: historical occurrences whose recorded B2 control decision is accepted AND complete_record under the dataset specification; no Phase-4 admission applied
E3.selection: uniform random subset of size b: numpy default_rng(seed).permutation(pool)[:b], seeds 13, 29, 43, 61, 79 (same construct() as canonical random rows)
E3.shortfall: pool smaller than b is recorded MATCHED_BUDGET_SHORTFALL/unavailable
E3.comparison: canonical selection/quality-coverage/s42 at the same b (same-environment re-score, with run-v2 values reported)

E4.name: Across-dataset summary of fresh-split curation
E4.datasets: run-v2 Track B (Abalone19, Ecoli4, page-blocks0; canonical budgets 56/70/49 and canonical generators, read from run-v2/results.csv, not recomputed) plus E1 datasets (winequality-red-4 recorded unavailable)

comparisons.QC_minus_admitted_random: combined/quality-coverage HYBRID_MINORITY minus combined/random HYBRID_MINORITY, paired by split
comparisons.QC_minus_real_only: combined/quality-coverage HYBRID_MINORITY minus REAL_TRAIN TRTR, paired by split
comparisons.best_augmentation_minus_real_only: per dataset, classifier and metric, the HYBRID_MINORITY method (six curators, RandomOverSampler+b, SMOTE+b or SMOTENC+b) with the highest five-split mean among methods available on all five splits, minus REAL_TRAIN TRTR. Selected on the same TEST splits, therefore optimistic by construction.

E4.dataset_level_difference: mean over splits where both sides have status ok; the number of paired splits is reported; a dataset with zero paired splits is unavailable for that comparison
E4.win_tie_loss: per split: difference > 0 win, == 0 tie, < 0 loss (exact comparison, no tolerance)
E4.wilcoxon: scipy.stats.wilcoxon on dataset-level mean differences per (comparison, classifier, metric); two-sided, zero_method='wilcox', method='auto'; exploratory, no multiplicity adjustment, no significance claim
E4.test_positives: report TEST positive count for every dataset and split

environment.python: 3.12 project venv; dependency versions pinned to artifacts/reports/empirical-v2/verification-v1/dependencies.txt (numpy 2.5.2, pandas 2.3.3, scipy 1.18.1, scikit-learn 1.9.0, imbalanced-learn 0.14.2, sklearn-compat 0.1.6)
environment.platform_note: Canonical run-v2 was produced on Windows; this addendum runs on macOS. Cross-platform last-bit floating differences are possible and are measured for the Track A comparators, not assumed away.
environment.historical_source: separate git worktree at 244a9bf with recorded bytes restored by scripts/restore_source_bytes.py (only exact recorded-hash reconstructions are written)

outputs: artifacts/reports/exploratory-addendum-v1/: manifest.json, results.csv (run-v2 results.csv columns), results.json, constructions.json, populations.json, unavailable.json, summary.json, summary.md, slide-numbers.md
